svg.title: Three visits, one circle
svg.desc: A circle touches three visits of the 11 / 6 curve. At an outward distance equal to its radius, about 10.17122, those visits meet at the center. Three equal-scale close-ups show a triangle before, at, and after this ordinary triple passage. A whole-orbit rational cover and a four-variable uniqueness proof certify exactly one triple and no touch inside the viewing square throughout the displayed interval. This is one selected local window, not an event census for the whole curve. The drawing uses rounded coordinates.

g.text: Move outward along the normals. One tangent circle becomes one triple meeting.
